landing.title: Money you can plan around
landing.headline: Money you can plan around.
landing.pitch: A balance tells you what you have. Tengo tells you until when.
landing.ctaNote: No sign up. Fictional data only.
landing.previewCaption: Built live from a fictional persona's 90 day history.

history.title: Add your money history
history.body: Use a sample person or bring a bank statement as a CSV file. It stays on your device.

last.title: See how long it lasts
last.body: Tengo works out the day your money runs out and when your next money usually lands.

plan.title: Plan around the date
plan.body: Try a what-if, check a loan to family, and see what is safe to spend today.

landing.fictional: All people, places and amounts in this demo are fictional. No bank connection.

picker.title: Choose a person
picker.lead: Each person is a fictional composite with a different way of earning. Pick one to see Tengo with their money.

thabo.situation: Cash fares most days and an app payout on Mondays. Fuel and the car instalment come first.

lerato.situation: Saturdays carry the week. Product restocks every two weeks and rent on the 1st.

ayanda.situation: Cash takings come in lumps. Big stock runs and prepaid electricity in between.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.lead: Here is what Tengo uses, why, and what you can change.

what.title: What we use
what.body: Transaction dates, amounts and descriptions, plus your current balance. Nothing else.

why.title: Why
why.body: To work out how long your money lasts and when your next money is likely. Not for marketing or credit scoring.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: Only you, on this device. No one at Tengo can see it in this demo.

where.title: Where it is processed
where.body: In your browser, on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.

how.title: How long we keep it
how.body: 12 months, then it is removed. You can delete it any time.

core.title: Forecast
core.body: Needed to use Tengo. Withdraw any time and the forecast pauses.

messages.title: Daily messages
messages.body: A short daily update with your date. Simulated, nothing is sent.

analytics.title: Product analytics
analytics.body: Helps improve Tengo. Off by default. No analytics runs in this demo.

consent.changeLater: You can change these any time in Privacy.

privacy.simulated: Simulated privacy controls. Not a compliance certification.

sts.title: Safe to spend today
sts.withBills: Each day until {{date}}, after {{bills}} in bills.
sts.noBills: Each day until {{date}}. No bills due before then.

stateCard.title: Cover
stateCard.enough: Covered until your next money, even on a heavier week.
stateCard.tight: Covered on a normal week. A heavier week runs out before your next money.
stateCard.short_one: Runs out {{count}} day before your next money is likely.
stateCard.short_other: Runs out {{count}} days before your next money is likely.

next.title: Next money
next.unknown: No regular income found yet. Tengo plans 30 days ahead.

scrubber.title: Next 30 days
scrubber.subtitle: If money lands as usual
scrubber.label: Pick a day in the next 30 days

why.title: Why this date
why.plain: We start with your balance today, take off bills on their due dates, and spend at your usual daily rate until the money reaches zero. That day is your date. Money you have not received yet is not counted.
why.chartLabel: How the balance runs down on a normal, light and heavy week
why.dailySpendHint: Light to heavy week: {{low}} to {{high}} a day

confidenceHint.low: Under 28 days. The range is wider.

rule.enough: Even a heavy week lasts until the latest likely next money.
rule.tight: A normal week lasts until the usual next money. A heavy week does not.
rule.short: A normal week runs out before the usual next money.

why.question: Question this result
why.notAdvice: This is an estimate from past patterns, not financial advice.

paused.title: Forecast paused
paused.body: You withdrew consent for the forecast, so Tengo is not using your data. Resume to see your date again, or delete your data.
